# isNull

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is `null`.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isNull() — Checks whether a value is `null`. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/base</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isNull(value: unknown): value is null;
```

Strictly `null`. `undefined` is a separate case — `isNil` covers both.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is `null`; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `value` to `null` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isNull(null); // => true
isNull(undefined); // => false
isNull(0); // => false
isNull(""); // => false
```
